vulnerability_cn: 用可操纵的即时池价换算奖励
vulnerability_en: Manipulable spot-pool quote used to convert accrued rewards
detail_cn: VECAndETH 先用时间和 rewardRate 算出 USDT 计价的应领额，再在 calculateUSDTToETH 中直接调用 PancakeRouter.getAmountsOut(USDT→ETH)。这是当前池子的即时价，不是抗操纵预言机。攻击者借入大量 Binance-Peg ETH，短时间改变 ETH/USDT 储备，让同一笔 USDT 奖励被换算成过多 ETH；getReward 按该结果从合约付款，攻击者再恢复交易并归还借款。回执可见受害合约向攻击者付 68.498286303203816978 ETH，向 fundAddress 付 7.610920700355979664 ETH；公开分析称净收益约 61.2 ETH，源表损失为 109,600 美元。
detail_en: VECAndETH first calculates a USDT-denominated accrual from time and rewardRate, then calculateUSDTToETH directly calls PancakeRouter.getAmountsOut on the current USDT-to-ETH pool. This is a manipulable spot quote, not a manipulation-resistant oracle. The attacker borrowed large amounts of Binance-Peg ETH, distorted ETH/USDT reserves, made the same USDT reward convert to too much ETH, received payment through getReward, restored the trades and repaid temporary liquidity. The receipt shows 68.498286303203816978 ETH paid to the attacker and 7.610920700355979664 ETH to fundAddress; public analysis reports about 61.2 ETH net and the sheet loss is USD 109,600.
